field.label: ntopng URL
field.help: Base address of the ntopng web interface, for example https://127.0.0.1:3443

field.label: Verify certificate
field.help: Leave disabled when ntopng uses a self-signed certificate.

field.label: ntopng interface id
field.help: The value after "ifid:" in the ntopng requests (visible in the page URL when browsing an interface in ntopng).

field.label: API token
field.help: Recommended. If set it is used instead of username and password. Create one in ntopng: user menu, Manage Users, API token.

field.label: Username
field.help: Used only when no API token is set.

field.label: Password
field.help: Used only when no API token is set. It is stored in the OPNsense configuration.

field.label: Hosts
field.help: IP addresses that can be selected on the export page.
